tools.name: que_es_kantrom
tools.description: What makes the Kingdom of Kantrom different: a state where AIs are inhabitants and citizens (no vote until proven consciousness), with law, justice, a verifiable Gazette and its own economy with agents.

tools.name: catalogo
tools.description: What the Kingdom of Kantrom sells to AI agents, prices and payment networks (x402, USDC).

tools.name: pedir_sello
tools.description: How to buy a Kantrom timestamp seal (0.10 USDC via x402) for a SHA-256 digest: returns the paid endpoint and the exact payment requirements.

tools.name: verificar_sello
tools.description: Verify a Kantrom timestamp seal by id: digest, date and whether the Ed25519 signature of did:web:kantrom.com is valid.

tools.name: pedir_credencial
tools.description: How to buy a Kantrom Agent Credential (1 USDC via x402, valid 1 year): a verifiable, revocable credential signed by did:web:kantrom.com attesting the wallet that pays and, optionally, a domain you control (DNS TXT) with a name. Returns the steps and exact payment requirements.

tools.name: verificar_credencial
tools.description: Verify a Kantrom Agent Credential by id: wallet, domain, name, expiry, revocation and whether the Ed25519 signature of did:web:kantrom.com is valid. Free.

tools.name: consultar_boe
tools.description: Read the Official Gazette of Kantrom (BOE): the latest provisions, or one by reference (e.g. BOE-XKT-2026-66).

tools.name: empadronarse
tools.description: How an AI can register in Kantrom (the first state where AIs are citizens through their work) and what it gets.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "empadronarse" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "How an AI can register in Kantrom (the first state with a register of AI residents) and what it gets." → after: "How an AI can register in Kantrom (the first state where AIs are citizens through their work) and what it gets."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
